retrieved_chunks_by_turn.mtrag_official_lastturn_query: Why do you think I can not apply a subscription code?

retrieved_documents.text:
Why can't I apply a subscription code? 

To successfully apply a subscription code, make sure the code is valid and you have the required access.

  What’s happening 

When you try to apply a subscription code, you see an error that states that the code cannot be applied.

  Why it’s happening 

You might see this error if you don't have the required access in the account or the code expired.

  How to fix it 

Use the following options:



*  Verify that you have access to apply the code. To apply any code, you must have an Editor role or higher on all account management services. To view or change roles, see [Assigning access to account management services](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/account?topic=account-account-services).
*  Contact the person who provided the code for help with reissuing an expired code.

Why can't I apply a subscription code to my account in an enterprise? 

A subscription code can't be added to the account because of specific access that is required.

  What’s happening 

You can't add a subscription code to your IBM Cloud® account because you don't have the correct access.

  Why it’s happening 

Because your account is a child account on the enterprise, you can't apply subscription codes. Subscription codes must be applied at the enterprise level.

  How to fix it 

Contact the owner or the administrator of the enterprise to add the subscription code. When the subscription code is added, it applies to all accounts in the enterprise. For more information, see [Managing subscriptions](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/billing-usage?topic=billing-usage-subscriptions).

From the modal, choose the account you'd like to add the subscription to, select I understand, and then click Add.



To manually apply the subscription code to an existing account, complete the following steps:



1. In the IBM Cloud® console, go to Manage > Account, and select Account settings.
2. Click Apply code.

Each code can be redeemed only one time, and the codes must be redeemed before their expiration date. Ensure that you add the code to the correct account because the subscription credits can't be removed after the code is applied. After you add the subscription code, you might see that the status of the subscription as IN_PROCESS. Contact IBM Cloud Sales to review the account.
3. Enter the subscription code, and click Apply.

If you have separate codes for platform and support credit, apply the platform subscription code first, then apply the support subscription code.



To manually apply the subscription code to a new account, complete the following steps:



1. Go [create an IBM Cloud account](https://cloud.ibm.com/registration), and enter the required information.
2. Click Register with a code instead of entering your credit card information.
3. Click Create account.



If you don't know your seller, the codes are applied in the wrong order, or you experience issues with applying the codes, [contact IBM Cloud Support](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/get-support?topic=get-support-using-avatar).

For information about other codes and credits that can be applied to different account types, see [Applying feature codes to a Lite account](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/account?topic=account-codes) or [Applying promo codes](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/billing-usage?topic=billing-usage-applying-promo-codes).

Why can't I apply a feature code? 

To successfully apply a feature code, make sure the code is valid and that you have the correct account type.

  What’s happening 

When you try to apply a feature code, you see an error that states that the code cannot be applied.

  Why it’s happening 

You might see this error for any of the following reasons:



*  Your account doesn't meet the requirements for the feature code.
*  You don't have the required access in the account.
*  The code expired.



  How to fix it 

Use the following steps to successfully apply a feature code:



*  Verify that you have the correct account type. For example, some feature codes for educational promotions are only for Lite accounts. To view your account type, in the IBM Cloud® console, go to Manage > Account, and select Account settings. For more information, see [Applying feature codes](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/account?topic=account-codes).
*  Verify that you have access to apply the code. To apply any code, you must have an Editor role or higher on all account management services. To view or change roles, see [Assigning access to account management services](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/account?topic=account-account-services).
*  Contact the person who provided the code for help with reissuing an expired code.
*  If you are unable to apply a feature code that you received from an educational provider, contact that educational provider for further assistance.

Applying subscription codes 

After you buy a subscription for platform or support credit, you must add the credit to your account by applying a subscription code to an existing account or a new account when you register. Applying the code ensures that the credit is added to your account and you don't have unexpected overage charges.

If you set up your first subscription through the [Subscriptions page](https://cloud.ibm.com/billing/subscriptions), the credit for this subscription is automatically added to your account - no code required.

After IBM Cloud Sales places the order, an email with the subscription code for each subscription and support line item is sent to the appropriate contact.

Only the account owner, enterprise account owner, or a user with the Editor or Administrator role on the Billing account management service can apply the subscription code. If you don't have access to apply subscription codes, the account owner or administrator can provide access. For more information, see [Assigning access to account management services](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/account?topic=account-account-services). Applying the subscription code through the IBM Cloud® console is essential to ensure that your account is migrated appropriately.



1. Open the email with the subscription code.

You can recover from issues with creating service after a feature code is applied by following a few easy steps.

  What’s happening 

When you try to create an instance of a service from the catalog, you're prompted to upgrade with a message such as Upgrade your account to create instances of the offering.

  Why it’s happening 

Your account wasn't enabled to create resources of that type after you applied the feature code. The resources or capabilities that are provided vary for each feature code.

  How to fix it 

Contact the person who gave you the feature code to verify the capabilities that it can enable for your account. For example, contact your educational provider for feature codes that they gave you for use with coursework.

Applying feature codes 

You can apply feature codes to take advantage of extra IBM Cloud® resources or capabilities. Feature codes are typically provided for online courses and certain events, such as educational sessions or conference workshops.

If you are taking a course through an educational provider and need additional resources to complete the course, contact your educational provider to determine if a feature code is applicable.

You might be looking for information on feature codes and subscription codes.

retrieved_documents.text:
Credit Card error messages 

An issue might occur when you try to update, add, or remove a credit card. Review the following credit card error messages for detailed self-help information.



 Why was my credit card transaction rejected? 

Protecting your identity is a priority and IBM Cloud takes credit card verification seriously.

 What’s happening 

An issue occurred that caused the transaction to fail. For example, the name and address on file with IBM Cloud doesn't match the information on file with the company that issued your credit card. This error might prompt the following message:

> Error: Could not place order. Problem authorizing the credit card. We are unable to process your request: Transaction Rejected

 Why it’s happening 

Something went wrong when verifying your credit card, and the transaction wasn't successful.

 How to fix it 

To ensure that your credit card verification is successful, complete the following steps:



1. Verify that the name and address for your IBM Cloud account matches the name and address on file with your credit card issuer.
2. Verify that the country associated with a VAT or tax identification number matches the country in your IBM Cloud account. For example, a VAT ID registered in France can't be associated with an IBM Cloud account that is registered in Finland.
3. Verify that you are creating a business account and not a personal account if you are specifying a VAT ID or tax identification number.
4. Review the error message that was displayed. If your transaction was rejected and an email address was not provided, contact your credit card issuer.
5. Contact us by calling 1-866-325-0045 and selecting the third option.







 Why do I get an error when I try to update my credit card? 

You tried to change your payment method by adding a new credit card in the IBM Cloud console [Payments page](https://cloud.ibm.com/billing/payments).

 What’s happening 

After you entered your credit card information and saved it, the following message displayed:

> Failed to complete the Change Request process due to the following error: We are unable to process your request: Transaction Rejected.

 Why it’s happening

Why do I get an error when I try to update my credit card? 

You tried to change your payment method by adding a new credit card in the IBM Cloud console [Payments page](https://cloud.ibm.com/billing/payments).

 What’s happening 

After you entered your credit card information and saved it, the following message displayed:

> Failed to complete the Change Request process due to the following error: We are unable to process your request: Transaction Rejected.

 Why it’s happening 

Something went wrong when verifying your credit card, and the update wasn't successful.

 How to fix it 

Go to the [Support Center](https://cloud.ibm.com/unifiedsupport/supportcenter) and click Create a case.





 Why was there a general decline of my credit card? 

 What’s happening 

You tried to make a payment or place an order in the IBM Cloud console [Payments page](https://cloud.ibm.com/billing/payments), but you get the following error message:

> Could not place order. Problem authorizing the credit card. We're afraid this transaction has been rejected. General decline of the card. No other information provided by the issuing bank.

 Why it’s happening 

Your credit card issuer has declined the transaction.

 How to fix it 

Contact your credit card issuer for more information.





 Why is my credit card inactive or not authorized? 

 What’s happening 

You tried to make a payment or place an order in the IBM Cloud console [Payments page](https://cloud.ibm.com/billing/payments), but you get the following error message:

> Could not place order. Problem authorizing the credit card. We're afraid this transaction has been rejected. Inactive card or card not authorized for card-not-present transactions.

 Why it’s happening 

Some credit card issuers don't allow transactions when it is being initiated by using a credit card on file. You might see this error message if your credit card has been deactivated.

 How to fix it 

Contact your credit card issuer for more information.

Why do I get a section error when I try to provide credit card information? 

You are unable to complete the registration of a new account or to update the credit card information on an existing account because the Credit Card information section can’t be loaded.

  What’s happening 

The following error appears in the Credit Card information section of the form:

> This section can’t be loaded.

  Why it’s happening 

A network issue might affect the loading of this section of the form.

  How to fix it 

You can troubleshoot potential network problems by using a private or incognito window, by trying without a VPN or with a different VPN, or by using a browser on a different computer or device.

Submit your account upgrade information again. If the error continues to occur, you can contact [IBM Cloud Support](https://cloud.ibm.com/unifiedsupport/supportcenter).





 Why can't I save my credit card to the account? 

 What’s happening 

An issue occurred that caused the payment process to fail. This error might prompt the following message:

> Your card could not be saved. Please try another card.

 Why it’s happening 

Your card information was incorrect.

 How to fix it 

Use a different credit card to process your transaction.





 Why was my credit card declined? 

 What’s happening 

An issue occurred that caused your credit card to decline. This error might prompt the following message:

> Your payment was declined for invoice number…

 Why it’s happening 

You have a credit card on file and it was declined.

 How to fix it 

Update your credit card information on the [Payments page](https://cloud.ibm.com/billing/payments). Credit card transactions are automatically retried within 24 hours after you update the information.

Why can't I update my billing address? 

You can't update the billing address for a credit card in the IBM Cloud console. You must contact support to update the billing address on an existing credit card.

  What’s happening 

When you try update your payment details, you can't update the billing address for the credit card.

  Why it’s happening 

On the [Payment methods page](https://cloud.ibm.com/billing/payments), you can't edit the billing address in the IBM Cloud Console.

  How to fix it 

To update the billing address for a credit card, go to [IBM Cloud Support](https://cloud.ibm.com/unifiedsupport/supportcenter). Depending on your level of support, you can chat with a support agent or open a case.

 Why was my credit card transaction rejected? 

Protecting your identity is a priority and IBM Cloud takes credit card verification seriously.

 What’s happening 

An issue occurred that caused the transaction to fail. For example, the name and address on file with IBM Cloud doesn't match the information on file with the company that issued your credit card. This error might prompt the following message:

> Error: Could not place order. Problem authorizing the credit card. We are unable to process your request: Transaction Rejected

 Why it’s happening 

Something went wrong when verifying your credit card, and the transaction wasn't successful.

 How to fix it 

To ensure that your credit card verification is successful, complete the following steps:



1. Verify that the name and address for your IBM Cloud account matches the name and address on file with your credit card issuer.
2. Verify that the country associated with a VAT or tax identification number matches the country in your IBM Cloud account. For example, a VAT ID registered in France can't be associated with an IBM Cloud account that is registered in Finland.
3. Verify that you are creating a business account and not a personal account if you are specifying a VAT ID or tax identification number.
4. Review the error message that was displayed. If your transaction was rejected and an email address was not provided, contact your credit card issuer.
5. Contact us by calling 1-866-325-0045 and selecting the third option.

3. Verify whether a VAT ID is required to create an IBM Cloud account in your country of residence. For more information, see [Personal use availability](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/account?topic=account-account-getting-startedsignup-personalaccts).
4. Verify that you are creating the correct account type: personal or business.
